summary:
## Review
- **Important, C3 remains incomplete:** selecting a terminal history task creates a permanent live subscription. `performSelectionHandoff` always calls `subscribe` after snapshot hydration at `frontend/src/runtime/controller.ts:240-260`, while `subscribe` unconditionally inserts the task into `desired` at `frontend/src/runtime/transport.ts:436-449`. `shouldSubscribe` is consulted only after an event is applied at `frontend/src/runtime/transport.ts:710-742`; a terminal task subscribed after its latest event receives no later frame, so reconciliation never runs. Repeatedly viewing completed tasks recreates the subscription accumulation C3 intended to fix.
- **Important, C2 is only transient-gap safe:** an unknown or permanently schema-incompatible event is dropped at `frontend/src/runtime/transport.ts:137-142,220-225`. The next valid event records a gap and triggers recovery at `frontend/src/runtime/transport.ts:703-733`, but `gapRecoveryCursors` permits only one forced recovery per cursor and is not cleared by socket replacement or natural reconnect (`frontend/src/runtime/transport.ts:372-379,589-610,643-674`). Replay therefore repeatedly drops the same bad event and all later durable state remains frozen. There is no tight reconnect loop, but there is also no REST-snapshot fallback, visible incompatibility state, or terminal escape.
- **Minor, C8 is not time-reactive:** expiry is calculated only during render at `frontend/src/components/UserInputDialog.tsx:162-167`; no timer schedules a render at the deadline. If the dialog renders before expiry and remains idle past it, the click handler still closes over `expired === false` at `frontend/src/components/UserInputDialog.tsx:176-188`, and buttons remain enabled at `frontend/src/components/UserInputDialog.tsx:436-485`. Existing tests cover already-expired and future-at-render cases, not crossing the deadline while mounted (`frontend/src/test/user-input-dialog.test.tsx:878-942`).
- **Blocker:** none.
